author: Livelikerw
observations: Points measured on the signed 2019 photograph after scaling to 800 by 600 pixels. Window corners refer to the inside of the light surround. Under foliage, the middle sash's left jamb and one side of the higher windows are interpolated from their visible frames. Projection depths are approximate within the 5–6.5 m range indicated by other street observations.

openings.detail: broad dark double sash, two leaves and four registers
lower edge hidden behind low red tile roof; the upper two glazed registers are partly visible
tall narrow sash with white stepped apron
two lower casements beneath a projecting white lintel
upper sash between branches, pale moulded head; left jamb partially occluded
tall window aligned below upper casements; lower corners screened by tree and inferred

roof: The sloping visible red tile strips, dark fascia and pale soffits constrain the streetward roof pitches. Each wing ends at an explicit shallow section behind its roof slope. The building depth, back walls, concealed lower storey and covered roof junction remain unmeasured.
left_gable: A separate small gable at the left edge of the photograph has no documented structural connection to the higher facade. Only the two connected heights directly above the central frontage are represented.
